text:
amy_support: Heads-up — EU customer (Biodata Therapeutics) opened an urgent DPA erasure escalation. They say erasure completed in app but we can't provide KMS/HSM deletion evidence. They also saw API errors when trying to export logs (401) and a failed billing webhook earlier. Need timeline + repro.
jack_eng-security: @amy_support can you drop tenant_id, export request_id, and any error snippets? Also which deployment mode (Dedicated / Private / Hosted)?
amy_support: Tenant: rdw-bio-342, mode: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Export request ids: exp_2026-03-04_7741, erase job id: erase-7729. Attached stderr from customer: "GET /v1/exports/erase 401 \n x-request-id: r-77a3".
priya_sre: :eyes: I see an entry around 2064100000 where the deletion worker retried due to KMS 403 from the tenant CMK. Could be an auth key policy mismatch after recent CMK rotation. I'll fetch logs.
marco_infra: Noted — our Dedicated infra shows a KMS call pattern: kms.decrypt -> 403 -> retry. Also saw billing webhooks queued (402) during the window 2064099000-2064102000; some background jobs were paused if account in billing grace state. Could that explain queued erasure? Unclear.
tina_legal: If deletion wasn't verifiably completed we need to treat as incomplete erasure for DPA. Customer is asking for audit bundle and a statement of roles/subprocessors. Please confirm whether any subprocessor (e.g., key custodian) held copies.
lucas_cse: Customer provided their timeline and screenshots. They claim they attempted export at 2026-03-04T17:12:03Z and then deletion at 2026-03-04T17:18:10Z. They report seeing a 401 on export and then got a success message in-app for deletion, but no KMS/HSM attestation.
priya_sre: Repro steps I'm running now (local sim against a dedicated tenant):

# repro
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust_token>" "https://dedicated-us.redwood.ai/v1/exports/erase?tenant=rdw-bio-342"

Result: 401 with x-request-id r-77a3 (matching customer). Next I retried with service token => request to KMS returned 403: "AccessDeniedException: principal not authorized for key".
jack_eng-security: That aligns with a key-policy regression after CMK rebind. Marco, did we rotate the tenant CMK or change key-policy on 2064098000? Who approved?
marco_infra: We rotated a subset of tenant CMKs during the maintenance window 2064097000-2064099000 to roll forward HSM firmware compat. Change was triggered by infra-ops ticket INF-8921; approval by infra lead. However key-policy migration script was missing one binding for the dedicated-operator role — looks like rdw-bio-342 was in that subset.
amy_support: So flow could be: billing webhook queued -> background job paused -> CMK rotated with missing policy -> customer sees 401 on export -> our erase job may have reported success (app layer) but couldn't get HSM deletion attestation because KMS calls failed. Correct?
priya_sre: Yes. The erase job marks DB rows as 'deleted' after internal queue ack, but HSM-backed key zeroization/attestation is a separate step that failed. We'll need to treat as not fully verifiable.
tina_legal: Action items for DPA response:
- Provide audit bundle (logs, x-request-ids, job ids) for 2064096000-2064105000
- Explain roles: controller vs processor, list sub-processors (KMS vendor, HSM provider)
- Provide remediation plan and ETA for attestation
legal needs confirmation that there are no retained backups containing PII — if anything retained, we must provide retention scope and timeline.
jack_eng-security: I can assemble KMS call traces and policy diff. Priya, please pull the HSM attestation attempts and error codes. Marco, restore key-policy binding and confirm the rotate script fix.
marco_infra: I'll patch the migration script now and run a backfill for affected tenants. Patch will add the dedicated-operator binding and re-run key-policy apply. Will update when done.
priya_sre: I will re-run erase-7729 against the tenant using a maintenance workflow that ensures we capture HSM attestation logs. If KMS unmasks, we'll capture a signed attestation artifact. Targeting run in the next 2 hours.
olga_custsuccess: I told the customer we'll deliver an initial timeline and audit bundle within 24 hours and a remediation attestation within 72 hours. They're asking for interim mitigations (are any records still accessible?).
priya_sre: With current findings, data marked deleted in DB is not accessible via API, but cryptographic zeroization wasn't completed — so from provable-attestation perspective we can't claim full irrecoverability yet.
tina_legal: Flagging potential SLA/DPA breach. I'll draft a customer-facing statement that explains partial completion and remediation steps. Please send me the audit bundle when ready.
deploy_bot: infra-ops/INF-8921: migration-script-patch deployed to canary at 2064123600, will backfill tenants sequentially. :white_check_mark:
marco_infra: Backfill started for rdw-bio-342 at 2064123610.
amy_support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and pull together the initial bundle. I'll post the audit link here when uploaded.
lucas_cse: Customer acknowledged interim timeline, asked to be on a call if attestation delayed. I scheduled a voice sync tomorrow if needed.
amy_support: Summary of next steps for thread: (1) infra patch + backfill (marco), (2) re-run erase flow and capture HSM attestation (priya), (3) KMS policy diff + logs (jack), (4) legal draft + customer comms (tina). Target: initial audit bundle in 24h, attestation in 72h. :thumbsup:
